condition: Summing cosines or sines at equally spaced angles around circle.
strategy: Real/imaginary part of geometric series sum of roots of unity; sum=0 unless full period.
subject: Precalculus

condition: Sum sin(kθ) or cos(kθ) for k=1 to n.
strategy: Multiply by sin(θ/2), use product-to-sum to telescope: [sin((n+1/2)θ) - sin(θ/2)]/[2 sin²(θ/2)].
subject: Precalculus

condition: sin θ + cos θ = k with |k|≤√2.
strategy: Rewrite √2 sin(θ+π/4)=k; or square: sin 2θ = ±(1-k²).
subject: Precalculus

condition: Trig function as quadratic in bounded variable u=cos θ or sin θ ∈[-1,1].
strategy: Complete square A(u-h)²+k; min/max by vertex position relative to [-1,1].
subject: Precalculus
warning: Verify algebra: expand back to match coefficients exactly.

condition: Expression quadratic in tan θ scaled by cos²θ.
strategy: Rewrite as cos²θ(t² + c t + d) = [t² + c t + d]/(1 + t²) where t=tan θ.
subject: Precalculus
warning: tan θ generally NOT root of quadratic even if roots relate to tan components.

condition: tan A = tan B where A,B linear in unknown.
strategy: A-B=nπ; solve linear equation, exclude tan undefined points.
subject: Precalculus

condition: Sum-to-product identities for sin A ± sin B, cos A ± cos B.
strategy: sin A - sin B = 2 cos((A+B)/2) sin((A-B)/2); cos A - cos B = -2 sin((A+B)/2) sin((A-B)/2).
subject: Precalculus
warning: Correct signs: sin diff→cos avg, cos diff→-sin avg.

condition: Infinite geometric trig series ∑ r^n sin/cos(nθ).
strategy: Complex form ∑ (r e^{iθ})^n = r e^{iθ}/(1-r e^{iθ}); take Re/Im parts.
subject: Precalculus
warning: Verify constant term, starting index, sign pattern before summing.

condition: Equation 1/sin x + 1/cos x = k.
strategy: Let s=sin x+cos x, p=sin x cos x; then s=kp, s²=1+2p gives quadratic in p.
subject: Precalculus
warning: Verify both root pairs; check quadrant signs.

condition: Parametric curve x=sin t, y=sin(nt) or multiple angles.
strategy: Eliminate t: sin(nt)=polynomial in sin t using multiple-angle formulas; substitute cos²t=1-sin²t.
subject: Precalculus

condition: Distance from point to parametric line P + tD.
strategy: Solve (Q-P-tD)·D=0 for t; distance = ||(Q-P)-tD||.
subject: Precalculus

condition: Plane through three points or line of intersection.
strategy: Normal = cross product of vectors between points; or λ(plane1) + μ(plane2) = 0.
subject: Precalculus

condition: Minimum distance between skew lines.
strategy: Parametrize P1 + sD1, P2 + tD2; minimize distance squared quadratic At² + Bst + Cs² + Dt + Es + F by completing square or vertex formula.
subject: Precalculus
warning: Verify coefficient signs before substitution; expand fully.

condition: Regular n-gon vertices as roots of unity.
strategy: Sum ω^{k_i}; |S|^2 = sum sum ω^{k_i - k_j}, reduce mod n using sum all roots = 0.
subject: Precalculus
warning: Verify vertex labeling matches geometric positions.

condition: Dot product of position vectors from circumcenter.
strategy: A·B = R² - c²/2 where c opposite angle C.
subject: Precalculus

condition: Angle bisector between two planes through given point.
subject: Precalculus
warning: Same signs → opposite sides of bisector equation.

condition: Projection matrix onto line spanned by u.
strategy: P = (u u^T)/(u^T u); symmetric, idempotent P^2 = P.
subject: Precalculus

condition: Reflection matrix over line through origin.
strategy: R = 2P - I where P projects onto line; direction is eigenvector with eigenvalue 1.
subject: Precalculus

condition: Cross product as matrix multiplication.
strategy: a × v = [a]_× v, skew-symmetric [[0,-a_z,a_y],[a_z,0,-a_x],[-a_y,a_x,0]].
subject: Precalculus

condition: Powers of cosines via multiple-angle formulas.
strategy: cos θ = (z + 1/z)/2, z=e^{iθ}; (cos θ)^n = 2^{-n} (z + z^{-1})^n, binomial expand, pair z^k + z^{-k} = 2 cos(kθ).
subject: Precalculus
warning: Only odd multiples for odd n; normalize by 2^n.

condition: Spherical coordinates outside standard ranges.
strategy: θ → θ mod 2π ∈[0,2π); φ > π → φ' = 2π - φ, θ' = θ + π.
subject: Precalculus

condition: Line-sphere intersection distance between points.
strategy: Quadratic At² + Bt + C = 0; distance = ||D|| √((B/A)² - 4C/A) = √Δ/√A.
subject: Precalculus

condition: Weierstrass substitution for rational trig functions.
strategy: t = tan(θ/2); sin θ = 2t/(1+t²), cos θ = (1-t²)/(1+t²), tan θ = 2t/(1-t²).
subject: Precalculus

condition: Determinant of tridiagonal matrix with constants.
strategy: Recurrence D_n = a D_{n-1} - b² D_{n-2}; solve characteristic equation.
subject: Precalculus

condition: Fourth vertex of regular tetrahedron given three.
strategy: Set dist(P,A)² = dist(P,B)² = dist(P,C)² = s²; subtract pairwise for linear system; keep integer coefficients.
subject: Precalculus
warning: Dividing loses integer solutions; verify distances.

condition: Product over roots of unity ∏(a - ζ_k).
subject: Precalculus

condition: Reflection of point over plane.
strategy: Line from A along normal intersects plane at P; reflected D = 2P - A.
subject: Precalculus
warning: Direction along normal n (not -n); verify midpoint on plane.
